name: unlinked.ai
description: AI-powered LinkedIn network search, profile exploration, and intro drafting for autonomous agents and MCP clients.

auth.scoping: Resolved server-side to the authenticated user. Accessible data is strictly limited to the caller's own profile and direct connections.

me.description: Authenticated caller's own profile and network counts

search_contacts.description: Semantic search restricted to caller's direct connections

get_profile.description: Read caller's own profile or direct connection's profile

draft_intro.description: Draft a short forwardable intro to a direct connection (read-only)

imports.description: List LinkedIn archive uploads and ingested record counts

mcp.setup: git clone https://github.com/IdeaFlowCo/unlinked.ai && cd unlinked.ai/mcp-server && npm install && npm run build

private_archive_availability.note: Private archive import, scoped hosted setup and AI search remain unavailable in the deployed product. No live invitation URL is advertised. See https://github.com/IdeaFlowCo/unlinked.ai/blob/main/docs/private-noos-staging.md for the default-off staging contract, consent and release gates; synthetic receipts do not verify this legacy backend.

browser_entry.note: No live private invitation or setup URL is advertised. Legacy auth/key fields describe historical API schemas.
